title: Implement Library Route Map phase 2
summary: Add selected-file dry-run route trace evidence based only on already loaded Queue, Completed, and Sample Validation rows.
reason: Operators need to inspect why an existing row would match a profile without probing files or launching pipeline work.
behavior_before: The Libraries tab could not show a selected-file route trace using existing runtime evidence.
behavior_after: A read-only trace endpoint and Libraries panel show backend profile matching, stale/missing evidence states, and review outcomes without probing or mutating files.
manual_validation: browser smoke route-map trace selector reached trace rows before unrelated queue-scope failure
selected-file trace edge cases covered: missing evidence, metadata gaps, disabled profile exclusion, deepest root match
rollback_plan: Remove the trace builder route, WebView trace panel, related tests, summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Trace route is GET/effect none only. It does not accept arbitrary probing, save settings, launch work, mutate queue state, or touch source/output/scratch files.
